name: glitter-mic
description: Glitter Mic - multiplayer + solo karaoke web game with blurred lyrics and fair voice scoring

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @glitter-mic/web" "npm run dev -w @glitter-mic/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @glitter-mic/scoring-core && npm run build -w @glitter-mic/api && npm run build -w @glitter-mic/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @glitter-mic/scoring-core && npm run typecheck -w @glitter-mic/api && npm run typecheck -w @glitter-mic/web
